_README: Copy to monsters/FRANK-NNN.monster.json. Every field below is required by MONSTER_SCHEMA.json unless marked optional. The validator (validate.py) checks: every non-novel organ_id resolves to ORGANS.jsonl; the F2 sentence is verbatim; the lightning experiment carries expected_if_alive / expected_if_dead / kill_condition / chance_floor / positive_control / ancestral_comparison; status is in the enum; at least one organ is NOT novel (a monster made only of novel organs is a new project, F5). The template itself is skipped by the validator (filename starts with _).
title: <what the assembled organism is, in one line>
premise_summary: <mechanism, not hope: what the organism DOES>

organs.contributes: <causal function HERE, not what it was>

why_combination_changes_boundary: <name the dossier and the kill-boundary layer this moves, and the mechanism by which recombination moves it>

modern_capability_enabling.capability: none: pure recomposition of era-1 organs
modern_capability_enabling.era_test: <how capability vs recomposition is separated (LAW N16)>

consumer.name: <real consumer>
consumer.consumption_proof: <the CONSUMPTION.jsonl row that would prove use>

measurable_consequence: <the number the consumer already reads that changes if alive>
strongest_alternative_explanation: <best non-monster explanation of a positive, and how the design separates it>

lightning_experiment.chance_floor: <P(result | no mechanism) and the null that yields it>
lightning_experiment.positive_control: <what the instrument is known to detect>

ancestral_comparison.ancestral_assembly: <historical assembly under the same instrument, or closest proxy>
ancestral_comparison.rationale: <why this measures evolutionary movement, or why infeasible>

vindication_disclaimer: A plausible modern reconstruction does not vindicate the historical agent, invalidate its autopsy, or constitute evidence that the original premise was correct. If this monster lives, the conditional viability frontier moved; Prometheus 1.0 did not succeed retroactively.
